query: The Luna Who Can't See Rules The Alpha
title: The Luna Who Can't See Rules The Alpha
synopsis: Rosalie, the eldest daughter of House Griffin, lost her sight saving her fiancé, Sevier. Yet she was betrayed by Sevier and her illegitimate half-sister Camilla. To be with Sevier, Camilla tricked the blind Rosalie into signing a marriage contract, forcing her to wed Rexer, the Wolf King rumoured to be cruel and bloodthirsty.But Rexer had long been secretly in love with Rosalie. He treated her with gentle kindness and used his powers to restore her sight temporarily. Pretending she remained blind, Rosalie watched Sevier and Camilla brazenly consummate their affair right before her eyes. Utterly broken, she publicly rejected the soul-bond contract with Sevier. She went along with the swapped marriage deal, delivering a crushing blow to the arrogant and blind Sevier.

query: My Brothers Loved Me Three Days After I Died
title: My Brothers Loved Me Three Days After I Died
synopsis: Noelle was blamed for her parents’ death and rejected by her brothers. After being killed by her adopted sister, Noelle gets three days to return as a ghost.When her brothers investigate her murder, they realize the sister they hurt for years was already dead.

query: Guardian to Groom
title: Guardian to Groom
synopsis: Secretly in love with her guardian and Alpha King, Calvin, Nora confesses on her 22st birthday, only to be cold-heartedly rejected. Heartbroken, she joins a lethal mission and takes a fatal hit. Facing her near-death, Calvin finally breaks his restraint—disowning her as guardian to claim her as his soulmate.

query: Swapped to Be the Don's Queen
title: Swapped to Be the Don's Queen
synopsis: In her past life, spitfire Veronica married a golden boy while her sweet sister got the ruthless Gunrunner Don. Both ended in tragedy. Reborn with a vengeance, Veronica swaps fiancés to enter the lethal underworld.Armed with razor-sharp wit and dangerous charm, she crushes her enemies, builds an empire, and tames the mafia king.

query: Ballerina For the Dangerous Don
title: Ballerina For the Dangerous Don
synopsis: A farm girl Ava escapes to New York after being sold by her stepmother and unexpectedly marries Gabriel, a wheelchair-pretending mafia boss. As love grows amid ballet dreams, betrayal, and a hidden identity, an emerald swan necklace reveals Ava is the lost daughter of ballet queen Yetta, and Gabriel’s childhood promise to marry her comes true.

query: His Forgotten Wife Is a Mafia Principessa
title: His Forgotten Wife Is a Mafia Principessa
synopsis: After seven years of marriage, Amanda finally conceives a child with her husband, Dante—only to watch helplessly as he strips their unborn baby of its inheritance rights for the sake of his childhood sweetheart. Heartbroken, she leaves and undergoes a dramatic transformation, emerging as the sole heir to a powerful Mafia dynasty. When Dante finally uncovers the truth, can he win back the wife who once loved him so deeply?

query: Touch My Sister, Face the Mafia King
title: Touch My Sister, Face the Mafia King
synopsis: Dressed as a janitor, Kane attends his sister Evelyn’s engagement party, only to face bitter insults from her fiancé Dorian and his snobbish family.But when the city’s most powerful tycoons drop to their knees in absolute fear, the horrified Winstons discover the truth: Kane is the Shadow King.

query: Billionaire Brothers Fall for Country Sisters
title: Billionaire Brothers Fall for Country Sisters
synopsis: When a special forces hero and his brilliant surgeon brother rescue two country sisters, one wild night changes everything. The surgeon falls hard for a married mother, while his marriage-averse brother accidentally gets her younger sister pregnant with quadruplets. Suddenly, love, family, and chaos come as a package deal.

query: Surprise! I Can Walk and You're Broke
title: Surprise! I Can Walk and You're Broke
synopsis: Billionaire heiress Alice fakes a disability for three years to test her fiancé’s love, only to catch him cheating with her best friend. On the day she dumps him, she marries a mysterious tycoon, reveals who she really is, and makes them both regret everything!

query: Marry My Cheating Ex's Mafia Father
title: Marry My Cheating Ex's Mafia Father
synopsis: To inherit her family's fortune, Cynthia must marry into the ruthless Costa mafia dynasty. A reckless one-night stand turns into her worst nightmare — he's her boyfriend's father. Betrayed by her lover and best friend, she enters a marriage of revenge... only to fall hopelessly for the dangerous man she swore to use. Passion, betrayal, and a mafia empire collide.

query: The 100th Divorce Was Final
title: The 100th Divorce Was Final
synopsis: After three secret years of humiliation, Deanna finally accepts Elton’s 100th demand for divorce. Only then does he learn she was the one who saved him from the fire years ago. Too late. Deanna has already married billionaire heir Jacob—and she’s never coming back.

query: Apocalyptic Wasteland: My Romance System Built Me a
title: Apocalyptic Wasteland: My Romance System Built Me a Harem
synopsis: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, mercenary Ethan awakens the weakest Love System ever. But the target bound to his system turns out to be Emily, an SSS-rank high-level mutant. A handshake earns him fresh meat. A first kiss grants him a vaccine. And a bond unlocks a genetic evolution serum… While others can only strengthen one ability at a time, Ethan can unlock every resource by taming a beautiful mutant. As her Affection Level skyrockets, the once-feral beast slowly bows to him. But her gaze grows increasingly dangerous—and increasingly passionate. With the Love System, Ethan rises from a wasteland mercenary to become the ultimate King of the Apocalypse.

query: When I Stopped Loving You
title: When I Stopped Loving You
synopsis: "Claire Bennett and Adrian Whitmore have been married for five years—during which Adrian has been cheating for four and a half. Once fiery and reckless for love, Claire was slowly tamed after Adrian silently allowed his family to control and punish her for years. But no one knew she had already filed for divorce in secret. When the story begins, only three days remain before the final judgment takes effect. His mistress, Mia, wants to replace Claire at any cost. She leaks intimate footage to frame Claire, then stages a fake yacht kidnapping. Forced to choose between his wife and Mia, Adrian doesn’t hesitate—he chooses Mia, even saying, “Don’t save her. Let her die.” After surviving, Claire attends Adrian’s last birthday party as his wife. On the very day her divorce becomes official, she leaves the U.S. and delivers the divorce decree as a “wedding gift” to the party Adrian is throwing for Mia. Only after Claire completely disappears does Adrian uncover the truth. He chases her to France, begging her to come back. But Claire has already met Eric Laurent, the heir who respects and protects her. Adrian’s regret twists into sick obsession, and he forcibly takes Claire away right before her wedding—only to lose her for good. Months later, Claire marries Eric in a seaside ceremony, finally closing the door on five years of pain."

query: I Won't Love You Again
title: I Won't Love You Again
synopsis: Lena Clermont fell hard for her dad's friend, Andrew Rohan—twelve years older. The first time she saw him, he was all sharp suits and broad shoulders, effortlessly standing out. He smiled, patted her head, and handed her a princess dress. Fast forward to twenty. He got drugged at a banquet. She wore that same dress, offering herself as the cure.

query: Mafia Queen Kills It in High School
title: Mafia Queen Kills It in High School
synopsis: Underworld queenpin Rosetta Romano dies saving a fallen girl—only to wake up in her body. She’s now Teresa Rossi, the abused true heiress replaced by a fake sister and hated by her own family. Craving a quiet life, Rosetta takes Teresa’s identity to chase a college dream, viciously avenging the girl who deserved better.

query: The Twins' Matchmaking Magical Trap
title: The Twins' Matchmaking Magical Trap
synopsis: Angel Eric and Demon Hailey fall deeply in love and have twin boys, but one misunderstanding tears them apart. Sixteen years later, their twin sons swap identities to play matchmaker and bring their parents back together.

query: Trapped With My Best Friend's Brother
title: Trapped With My Best Friend’s Brother
synopsis: "College student Riley Samuels, fresh out of a four-year relationship, accepts a last-minute invitation from her best friend, Lily, to visit the Atwood family’s vacation cabin in the remote, snow-covered mountains. Expecting Lily’s older brother, Caleb, to be absent, she is shocked to wake up in bed beside him—wearing his oversized sweater—three days after settling into his room. The lanky boy who once loved to tease her has grown into a powerfully built man with a dangerous aura and a knack for flirtation. Though Riley still claims to find him annoying, she cannot help but be captivated by his voice, scent, physique, gaze, and every move he makes as he draws closer to her. After an earthquake triggers an avalanche, the cabin is buried under twenty-five to thirty feet of snow, cutting them off from the outside world. The struggle for survival draws them closer together. Caleb finally confesses that his childhood teasing wasn't born of dislike, but was a cowardly way to mask his secret crush on her. They officially become a couple, but as rescue is delayed and their firewood runs out, Riley begins to show signs of hypothermia. Caleb ventures out alone to seek help. Riley was rescued, but Caleb was nowhere to be found. After days of agonizing suspense, the two finally reunited and acknowledged their true feelings for each other. A year later, they were married in the presence of family and friends."

query: The Last Man's Apocalypse Harem
title: The Last Man’s Apocalypse Harem
synopsis: "Sam was only a worthless scavenger in a zombie apocalypse. Until a mysterious system gave him power, resources, and three women by his side. Rising from the ruins, he will conquer the wasteland and become its king—with his three wives standing beside him."

query: The Betrayed Guardian: The Empire Begs Him Back
title: The Betrayed Guardian: The Empire Begs Him Back
synopsis: For ten years, Arthur stood alone against the Abyss. But the new Empress Valeria fell for a pack of lies and branded him a fraud, leaving the entire Empire to despise him. And that’s when the Archfiends emerged from the Abyss.

query: I Refused the Moretti Name
title: I Refused the Moretti Name
synopsis: I have never been good at pretending not to notice when someone is manipulating me. When I was fourteen, a girl in my math class slipped a cheat sheet onto my desk as the teacher walked down our row. “Hold this for me,” she whispered. “Just until the test is over.” She expected me to hide it. Instead, I raised my hand. “Ms. Carter, Jenna put her cheat sheet on my desk and asked me to keep it for her.” No one at school ever asked me to “hold” something for them again. Then Lorenzo Moretti, Don of one of New York’s oldest families, found me and told me I was the daughter he’d lost twenty-five years ago. He held a dinner to introduce me to the family. Before I arrived, Sofia—the daughter they had raised—hid my place card and took the seat between my parents. “I’ve sat here for twenty-one years,” she said sweetly. “You don’t mind, do you?” Everyone expected me to smile, sit somewhere else, and prove I wasn’t a threat. I put my place card back on the table. “If this seat means nothing, why did you need mine?” Sofia cried. My mother rushed to comfort her, my three brothers followed her out, and my father lectured me about keeping the peace. It wasn’t the first time. They had missed three of my birthdays for Sofia, given her the bracelet engraved with my name, and turned the rooms promised to me into her private studio. Every broken promise came with a reasonable excuse, but every excuse ended the same way: Sofia came first, and I was expected to understand. They all believed I would tolerate anything for the Moretti name, their money, and their protection. The next morning, they abandoned me at the courthouse during my name-change appointment because Sofia claimed she couldn’t breathe. So I withdrew the petition, kept the name my adoptive mother gave me, and moved out with one suitcase. But after I left, why did every one of them regret it?

query: They Loved Me Too Late
title: They Loved Me Too Late
synopsis: Erin Harrington is the only daughter of one of New York’s old-money families. After losing her parents at a young age, she was doted on by her three older brothers and her childhood sweetheart, Adrian. To Erin, they were not just family—they were her entire world. Three years ago, Erin met Chloe, a young woman with no one to rely on, through a charity project. Out of kindness, Erin personally brought her into the Harrington family. She never imagined that from that moment on, the affection of both her brothers and the man she loved would slowly begin shifting toward Chloe. What no one knows is that six months earlier, Erin had already been diagnosed with osteosarcoma and urgently needed to travel to Boston for high-risk treatment. On the morning she and Adrian finally complete their civil marriage, Erin believes she is about to begin the life she has always wanted. But that very afternoon, because of Chloe, she is pressured into signing an application to annul the marriage. That is the moment Erin finally wakes up. She stops fighting, stops explaining, and decides to use her upcoming surgery—and a carefully staged “death”—to make Erin Harrington disappear from New York completely. Everyone assumes her sudden changes are nothing more than jealousy, attention-seeking, and another childish tantrum. Only when news of her death finally reaches them do they discover that Erin had been seriously ill all along. By then, they also begin to uncover the truth behind Chloe’s years of manipulation and deliberate attempts to turn them against Erin. Three years later, Erin has successfully completed treatment and is living under a new identity. She rebuilds Sunrise House, the shelter that once gave her a temporary place to stay, and meets Eli—a man who never uses love as an excuse to control or pressure her. A news report eventually reveals that the family she left behind is still trapped in regret. Soon afterward, an old land-rights issue involving Sunrise House is suddenly froze

query: Lost Her Once Regret It Twice
title: Lost Her Once Regret It Twice
synopsis: She was bled dry to save her twin brother, then thrown away. Eighteen years later, the discarded Carter heiress returns to her family's company as a poor cleaner’s daughter—only to be tormented unknowingly by the regretful family desperately searching for her. When the truth finally surfaces, love and cruelty collide in blood.

query: The Child Beneath the Pool Cover
title: The Child Beneath the Pool Cover
synopsis: Hearing cries for help from beneath the enclosed pool cover, Black Marcus was blocked bythe boy s father and grandmother, who mistook him for a trespasser-until he rescued their missing son.

query: Living Under the Dragon's Roof
title: Living Under the Dragon's Roof
synopsis: In her past life, Seraphina was killed by her own husband—after he murdered their child. Reborn with her memories intact, she breaks free from that scumbag and chooses the Third Prince of the Dragon Clan, a man hiding his true power. Together, they take revenge and seize control of the Dragon Clan.

query: Nanny For Hire Mommy Forever
title: Nanny For Hire Mommy Forever
synopsis: Her husband cheated. Her best friend stole her family. Her daughter chose another mother. Left with nothing, Serena is swept into the world of a wealthy, possessive billionaire whose little girl calls her “Mommy”. When he makes her an offer to give her everything she ever lost, how can she refuse?

query: Oops! I Splashed the Secret Billionaire Then Married Him
title: Oops! I Splashed the Secret Billionaire Then Married Him
synopsis: Out to catch her best friend’s cheating fiancé, small-town girl Ava dumps a bucket of ice water on the wrong man: billionaire CEO Ewan Waltmore. One crazy mix-up later, she’s his wife. They agree to divorce in a week, but he falls first—and she’s secretly the shareholder who controls his empire!

query: Reborn Dragon Princess Cuts Off Her Three Brothers
title: Reborn Dragon Princess Cuts Off Her Three Brothers
synopsis: Betrayed and killed by her adopted brothers and the girl she once saved, White Dragon Princess Cecilia is reborn to sever all ties with them. She accepts Dragon King Edward’s proposal, finding the love she deserves. When the truth is revealed, her betrayers can only regret losing her.

query: The Daughter They Betrayed Became Their Downfall
title: The Daughter They Betrayed Became Their Downfall
synopsis: Raised by the billionaire Reyes family, Florence returns to her biological family, the Morrisons, only to be framed for murder by adopted daughter Audrey. After four years in prison, Florence clears her name, cuts ties with the family that betrayed her, and rebuilds her life as a brilliant scientist.

query: Done Loving My Alpha
title: Done Loving My Alpha
synopsis: Nova marries the ruthless Alpha in place of her runaway sister. When she nearly loses their pup, he sends every healer away—to save her sister’s lilies instead. That is the moment Nova finally gives up on him and walks away for good.

query: Broken Vows: The Goddess Casts You Down
title: Broken Vows: The Goddess Casts You Down
synopsis: She saved war god Enyalius with her blood, yet he gave his heart to her sister. Betrayed and tortured for three years, half-goddess Halie lost even her child before fleeing to the Abyss to marry a cursed demon. Now Enyalius will burn heaven and hell to reclaim her—but will she let him?
